name: Dakshineswar Kali Temple
summary: Dakshineswar — riverside Kali temple central to modern Bengal’s spiritual history.

mythology: Dakshineswar Kali Temple at Dakshineswar, Kolkata, West Bengal is dedicated to Goddess Kali (Bhavatarini), known especially for Rani Rashmoni’s temple linked to Sri Ramakrishna. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Goddess Kali (Bhavatarini) blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.
